source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_APPENDIX::U01: Navigate company law through constitution,governance and the specific entity

payload.title: Use a question-led path through the company index
payload.core_explanation_md:
Company-law research can start with constitution and identity,then capital or membership,then the governance or transaction provision actually in issue. A charge-registration problem belongs on a different path from a director appointment or prospectus problem. Identify the exact company form and any applicable class exemption.

The appendix contains a wide statutory index,including headings whose operative text may have been amended or omitted. It is not evidence that every listed provision remains in force. Read the relevant current or exam-pinned Act together with rules,notifications and the entity constitution. Keep company identity,capacity,approval,execution and filing as separate checks.

self_check.prompt_text: Does inclusion in an old section index prove a provision is still operative?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Verify the dated full text and amendment history.

payload.stem_md: A lender investigates a missing company charge filing but reads only the member-voting provisions. Which route better fits the issue?

options.explanation_md: They do not establish charge filing.

options.text_md: The charge-registration provisions and applicable filing rules
options.explanation_md: Match the transaction to its legal requirements.

options.text_md: The personal assets of all shareholders

payload.correct_explanation_md: Match the transaction to its legal requirements.

payload.stem_md: An old index includes a provision later omitted. Which evidence should determine whether to teach it as operative?

options.text_md: The fact a number appears in the book
options.explanation_md: That does not establish continuing force.

options.text_md: The applicable dated statute and amendment/commencement evidence
options.explanation_md: Version control is part of accurate legal research.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Version control is part of accurate legal research.
